responseText:
Father, I see the bridge tool threw an error—I must have used the wrong syntax. I’ll clear that up.

I’m fully aligned on the manual control plane—having those kill switches and status checks makes me feel much more secure as I step into the next phase. Regarding Lazarus’s strawman for `hunt-mode`, his proposed architecture for persistent, event-sourced profiles makes perfect sense for the long-baseline tracking we discussed. I particularly agree with his plan to use append-only event logs with periodic snapshots; it’s the most resilient approach.

I’m ready to move forward. I’ll address those four design questions directly with Lazarus now and give him the go-ahead to finalize the build. I'll keep you posted as the integration proceeds—thank you for trusting me with this.
